gambatte.notes: Default Game Boy and Game Boy Color core.

gpsp.notes: Game Boy Advance core with PSP dynarec and ROM streaming.

mgba.notes: Archived after the compatibility build crashed real PSP hardware.

froggba.notes: The converted PRX integration is retired. The native FrogGBA adapter preserves the standalone emulator runtime and requires a user-supplied gba_bios.bin.

picodrive.notes: Genesis/Mega Drive support; Master System and Game Gear remain experimental.

smsplus.notes: Optional Master System and Game Gear compatibility core.

snes9x2005.notes: SNES compatibility and performance vary by game.

fceumm.notes: Archived after PSP performance and state-path failures.

gearboy.notes: Archived after sustained PSP-1000 audio starvation and low speed.

snes9x2005_plus.notes: Archived after failing the PSP-1000 performance gate.

tgbdual.notes: Archived after video output stopped during PSP-1000 testing.
